target: small prototype batch, 24 V temperature B; A shared across future B supply variants

before_order.action: Measure purchased diymore 30P board: row spacing, outline, pin labels, header insertion height and USB position. Current 25.40 mm spacing is an authorized assumption.

Approve every MPN, stock and quote; check all manufacturer drawings, land patterns, pinouts, MLCC effective capacitance and substitutions. C9/R13 and JP1 header/shunt candidates identified but not released.

Qualify the purchased DevKit power path and a specific USB service arrangement. Ordinary USB + external 5 V remains prohibited. USB-only disconnected service is retained; powered monitoring is not yet available.

Nominal 24 V startup peak 4.88 A is below L1 Isat1 6.5 A at 25 C. Nonlinear saturation, hot tolerance, surge/current-limit and fuse coordination remain unqualified; review package and prototype test plan before order.

Quote factory SMT plus THT and two separate 1x15 sockets under U1/A. Approve polarity, native rotations, soldering process, heights and 2 oz B capability in manufacturer preview. No automatic substitutions.
Fresh ERC/DRC and source-bound BOM/CPL/Gerber/drill exports are for review only. Re-export after any native change; approve Gerber/drill appearance and board specs before release.

after_prototype_before_operating_heater.action: Migrate PWM GPIO5 to25, handle ENABLE, ADS1115 address0x49, NTC calibration and safe behavior at boot/lost or invalid measurement. Verify real output off on faults.
Execute electronics_bench_plan.md: limited-current bring-up, startup/load/wifi, thermal, PWM/NTC noise, wiring and fault tests.
Define application-dependent independent overtemperature protection and its wiring. No independent thermal cutoff is present on current PCB.
Print clip/rail coupon; check actual DevKit/socket/LCD stack, USB fit, connector grip and fully wired board removal. Verify enclosure temperatures.

future_variants.action: Review complete B protection/current/load and additional line/load conditions; do not carry 100 W rating over to 12 V.
Design protected low-drop 5 V distribution or other converter appropriate to source range. Current LM2596 input is not a 5 V pass-through.
